notes: ORTHOGRAPHY CAVEAT: the kuran.diyanet text is the original wording in lightly modernised spelling (şüphesiz, hakikaten, Rabbin, "Allah Tealâ'nın adıyla (Okumaya başlarım)" at 1:1) and it re-divides some sentences across ayat (22:42-43, 89:19-20, 91:14-15). kuranmeali.com "Elmalılı Meali (Orijinal)" keeps the 1935 spelling (şübhesiz, hakıkaten, rabbının, va'dinde) and is the better witness for the original orthography; acikkuran (author 14) = mealler.org (~99%), same e-text as kuranmeali but circumflex-stripped on acikkuran. Agreement with each is only ~70-75% per ayah for these reasons, not because of different translations. 40 merged verse groups stored once as a..a_end. Cross-check over S1, S22, S87-114 (primary kuran.diyanet.gov.tr meal ML=6) - acikkuran.com "Elmalılı Hamdi Yazır": n=373, exact 2.1%, loose 70.5%, sim 0.987; â/î/û in 0.0% of ayat (primary 40.2%); bracket counts differ in 4 ayat (e.g. 1:1, 22:32, 22:78); verse groups 0 vs 2; most divergent 22:43 (sim 0.38) | kuranmeali.com "Elmalılı Meali (Orijinal)" (elmaliliorj): n=373, exact 4.8%, loose 74.5%, sim 0.984; â/î/û in 40.8% of ayat (primary 40.2%); bracket counts differ in 3 ayat (e.g. 1:1, 22:65, 112:1); verse groups 0 vs 2; most divergent 89:20 (sim 0.37) | mealler.org "Elmalılı Hamdi Yazır": n=373, exact 4.0%, loose 70.5%, sim 0.988; â/î/û in 40.2% of ayat (primary 40.2%); bracket counts differ in 4 ayat (e.g. 1:1, 22:32, 22:78); verse groups 0 vs 2; most divergent 22:43 (sim 0.38).
